caption:
Lulu lifts and carries boxes all day at the warehouse, and lately her back feels stiff by the end of every shift.

Twisting while holding a load, or lifting it far from your body, can add strain to the back. Building trunk and hip strength may help your body handle the load of repeated lifting.

Hybi's tip: hold boxes close, move your feet to turn instead of twisting, and take short breaks to stand tall and stretch.

Pain spreading down your leg, numbness or weakness, or back pain at night are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physio-led clinical Pilates team can help. Book online via the link in bio
